text: Access hundreds of models from many providers through one unified API and single key
quote: One key, hundreds of models. Access models from multiple providers with a single API key

text: Automatically retries requests to other providers if one fails, improving reliability
quote: High reliability. Automatically retries requests to other providers if one fails

text: Generate vector embeddings for search, retrieval, and other tasks
quote: Embeddings support. Generate vector embeddings for search, retrieval, and other tasks

text: Monitor spend across providers with a usage dashboard showing key metrics
quote: Spend monitoring. Monitor your spending across different providers

text: Bring your own provider API keys with zero markup on token costs (BYOK)
quote: No markup on tokens. Tokens cost the same as they would from the provider directly, with zero markup, including with [Bring Your Own Key (BYOK)]

text: Point existing OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs or clients at the gateway via a URL/base-URL swap with no code rewrites
quote: You can use existing OpenAI client libraries, switch to AI Gateway with a URL change, and keep your current tools and workflows without code rewrites.

text: Control which providers handle requests, in what order, and how they're ranked via order/only/sort options
quote: You can use `order`, `only`, and `sort` in `providerOptions.gateway` to control which providers handle your requests, in what order, and how they are ranked.

text: Set per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover when a provider is slow
quote: You can set per-provider timeouts to trigger fast failover when a provider is slow to respond.

text: Automatically applies an appropriate caching strategy per provider via caching:'auto'
quote: You can use `caching: 'auto'` in `providerOptions.gateway` to let AI Gateway automatically apply the appropriate caching strategy based on the provider.

text: View detailed, searchable/filterable request logs with export to CSV or JSON
quote: open the Logs page, where you can search by request ID, filter by model, provider, or status code, follow requests live, and open one request to see how it was routed. You can also export the filtered list as CSV or JSON.

text: Falls back to gateway's own system credentials if a request using your own credentials fails
quote: If a query using your credentials fails, AI Gateway will retry the query with its system credentials to improve service availability.

text: Automatically provides OIDC tokens for Vercel-deployed apps, removing need to manage or rotate secrets
quote: For applications deployed on Vercel, OIDC tokens are automatically available as VERCEL_OIDC_TOKEN. No secrets to manage, no keys to rotate. It just works.

text: Public models endpoint (no auth needed) returns model IDs, context windows, and pricing
quote: This endpoint requires no authentication and returns detailed information including model IDs, context windows, and pricing.

text: Set budgets to cap spending per team, project, API key, or team member
quote: To cap how much your team, a project, an API key, or a team member can spend, set [budgets]

text: Migrate existing provider integrations to AI Gateway
quote: Move an existing provider integration | [Migrate to AI Gateway](/docs/ai-gateway/getting-started/migrate-to-ai-gateway)

text: Requests dashboard shows summaries by project, API key, and detailed request logs
quote: The Requests section displays summaries by project, API key, and a detailed log of all requests.

text: Pass per-request provider credentials via byok option in providerOptions.gateway
quote: you can pass provider credentials on a per-request basis using the byok option in providerOptions.gateway. This is useful when you need to use different credentials for specific requests

text: Use Chat Completions API compatible with OpenAI client libraries and AI SDK by pointing to gateway base URL
quote: You can use the AI Gateway's Chat Completions API with existing tools and libraries like the OpenAI client libraries and AI SDK. Point your existing client to the AI Gateway's base URL

text: Sort providers by performance or cost metric and try them in that ranked order
quote: You can also use `sort` to rank providers by a performance or cost metric. The gateway sorts providers by the chosen metric and tries them in that order

text: Usage section displays four metrics to monitor AI Gateway activity
quote: The Usage section displays four metrics to help you monitor your AI Gateway activity.

text: Query models endpoint directly for JSON list of all available models with pricing and capabilities
quote: Query the models endpoint directly to get a JSON list of all available models with pricing and capabilities

text: Setup guide for connecting coding agents to AI Gateway
